name: Account Token Tracker
description: Tracks per-account quota % and per-model usage, estimating monthly dollar value ($/mo) week-over-week and month-over-month to detect quota enshittification.

statusBarItems.tooltip: 계정별 % 대비 모델별 사용량 및 달러 환산 가치($/1%) 감시 (클릭하여 새로고침)

settings.title: Polling interval (seconds)
settings.description: How often to sample account rate limits and session usage.

settings.title: Maximum raw ledger entries
settings.description: Number of individual percentage-jump records to keep (weekly/monthly rollups are kept permanently).

settings.title: Enshittification alert threshold (% drop)
settings.description: Flag a warning when weekly/monthly $/1% value drops by at least this percentage compared to the baseline period.

settings.title: Custom model pricing overrides (JSON)
settings.description: Optional JSON map of model ID to USD per 1M tokens, e.g. {"claude-opus-5-5":{"input":5,"output":25}}.
